sql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1.share > T2.share THEN 'Python'
    WHEN T2.share > T1.share THEN 'SQL'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS more_in_demand
FROM (
  SELECT
    share
  FROM mart_skill_demand
  WHERE
    skill = 'python'
) AS T1
CROSS JOIN (
  SELECT
    share
  FROM mart_skill_demand
  WHERE
    skill = 'sql'
) AS T2
